name: gclbck-crealore-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Crealore. Add this marketplace once and install any of them.

plugins.name: is-it-done-yet
plugins.description: A progress pane beside the Claude Code terminal for big, multi-phase work. Open it in any existing project: it looks through the folder's markdown files, finds the plan, checklist or progress note by reading what they say (no file names built in), or uses the agent's task list, then shows overall percent, an accordion of phases and tasks with green/blue/grey bars, elapsed time, a rough ETA, total tokens and the API-equivalent cost. Adds nothing to the model's context. Reach L1: reads the project's markdown files and the transcript's task calls; no processes, environment variables or network.

plugins.name: session-handoff-button
plugins.description: A Session Hand-off button above the prompt, green/orange/red by context usage (45% and 65% thresholds). While green it reads Context clean and cannot be pressed; from orange on, one press runs your handoff skill (or a built-in prompt), saves the handoff to a temp .md, runs /clear and continues in the fresh session with a short message, the handoff riding along as hidden context, so nothing is pasted on screen. Past 65% it stops your next prompt once and recommends the button. Reach L2: drives Claude (one handoff turn, /clear, one prompt); writes one temp file per handoff; no processes or network.
